fields.mechanism: Surface modification of the stainless steel plate heat exchanger to reduce biofilm development and scale accumulation.
fields.intervention: Apply a modified-surface coating to the stainless steel plate heat exchanger, such as a hydrophobic or antimicrobial coating, to reduce biofilm formation and scale accumulation.
fields.expected_effect: The modified-surface coating is expected to reduce biofilm development and scale accumulation, thereby maintaining a heat transfer coefficient above 2500 W/m2K for 12 months.
fields.falsification_test: Measure the heat transfer coefficient of the modified-surface coated plate heat exchanger after 12 months of operation in the district cooling loop, and compare it to the baseline value. If the heat transfer coefficient falls below 2500 W/m2K, the intervention is considered unsuccessful.
fields.mechanism_source_span: "A comparison of biofilm development on stainless steel and modified-surface plate heat exchangers during a 17-h milk pasteurization run."
